title: Sleepy parrot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- perch branch -->
  <rect x='12' y='78' width='76' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='12' y='78' width='76' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b07a42'/>
  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d='M28 66 L18 92 L26 90 L30 74 Z' fill='#1f7a4d'/>
  <path d='M30 66 L24 93 L32 91 L34 72 Z' fill='#2e9e63'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='62' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#2e9e63'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='64' rx='12' ry='15' fill='#4fc27f'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M40 52 q16 4 12 22 q-14 6 -18 -6 q-2 -12 6 -16 Z' fill='#1f7a4d'/>
  <path d='M42 56 q10 4 8 16 q-10 2 -12 -6 q0 -8 4 -10 Z' fill='#38ad6c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='40' r='15' fill='#2e9e63'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='42' r='10' fill='#4fc27f'/>
  <!-- cheek patch -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='4' fill='#f4c33d'/>
  <!-- sleepy eye (curved closed lid) -->
  <path d='M46 38 q5 4 10 0' stroke='#102a1c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- small cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#f28fae'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M64 40 q10 2 8 8 q-6 2 -10 -3 Z' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <path d='M64 40 q10 2 8 8 q-4 -1 -6 -4 Z' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- head feather tuft -->
  <path d='M50 26 q2 -8 6 -6 q-1 5 -3 7 Z' fill='#2e9e63'/>
  <path d='M55 25 q4 -7 7 -4 q-2 5 -4 6 Z' fill='#38ad6c'/>
  <!-- zzz sleepy marks -->
  <path d='M72 22 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#8fd8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M80 14 h4 l-4 4 h4' stroke='#bee8ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
